changelog:
Initial release of hiring-memory skill powered by BlueColumn persistent memory.

- Enables agents to store, recall, and search candidate and interview context.
- Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
- Provides simple endpoints for adding and retrieving candidate notes and interview memories.
- Ideal for use in recruiting workflows and candidate pipeline management.
summary: Give AI agents Remember candidates and interviews. using BlueColumn persistent memory. Use when an agent supports recruiting and interviews; when the user wants to store, recall, or search hiring memory context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
